name: paper-collage-artposter
description: 剪纸拼贴·艺术史海报版:深炭底 + 米卡撕边标题条(宋体) + 藏蓝/芥黄/砖红真纸件。Jane 审美专题海报同款语言,配 paper-collage 工作流 B。
container_style: max-width:677px; margin:0 auto; padding:24px 14px; background:#2A2A28; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Helvetica Neue','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;

tags.h1: display:inline-block; background-image:url({{asset:bar-cream}}); background-size:100% 100%; color:#26221C; font-family:STSongti-SC-Black,'Songti SC',STSong,'Noto Serif CJK SC',serif; font-size:20px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:2px; line-height:1.5; padding:13px 24px; margin:36px 0 18px; transform:rotate(-1deg);
tags.h2: display:inline-block; background-image:url({{asset:bar-cream}}); background-size:100% 100%; color:#26221C; font-family:STSongti-SC-Black,'Songti SC',STSong,'Noto Serif CJK SC',serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:2px; line-height:1.5; padding:12px 22px; margin:36px 0 16px; transform:rotate(-1deg);
tags.h3: display:inline-block; background-image:url({{asset:bar-navy}}); background-size:100% 100%; color:#F0EADB; font-family:STSongti-SC-Black,'Songti SC',STSong,'Noto Serif CJK SC',serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.5; padding:10px 18px; margin:28px 0 14px; transform:rotate(0.5deg);
tags.p: font-size:15px; line-height:1.95; color:#D8D2C2; margin:16px 0; letter-spacing:0.3px; text-align:justify; word-break:break-word;
tags.blockquote: background-image:url({{asset:panel-cream}}); background-size:100% 100%; border:none; padding:26px 26px; margin:26px 6px; color:#5C5344; font-size:15px; line-height:1.85; transform:rotate(-0.5deg);
tags.code: background:#3A3835; color:#E8D9A8; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:3px; font-size:13px; font-family:Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
tags.pre: background:#1E1D1B; color:#D8D2C2; padding:16px; overflow-x:auto; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; border:1px solid #3A3835;
